title: ComplyFlow Power Automate Flow Architecture Specification
description: Local Power Automate design and reference artifact — NOT an exported cloud flow package. Outlines trigger definitions, action chains, and logic expressions for manual configuration in Power Automate.

actions: Get matching policy from SLAPolicies by RiskLevel
Calculate TargetDueDateTime via addHours()
Update ComplianceRequests with SLA target and approval requirements
Create milestone record in RequestAuditLog (ActionType: Submitted)
Send confirmation email receipt to RequesterEmail
Verify AssignedAnalyst column modified via Get Changes token
Update Status to 'Under Review'
Create milestone record in RequestAuditLog (ActionType: Assigned)
Dispatch assignment notification card to AssignedAnalyst
Create milestone record in RequestAuditLog (ActionType: Approval Requested)
Determine approver role (Critical -> Head of Compliance, High -> Team Lead)
Start and wait for an approval card (Approve/Reject)
Update ComplianceRequests with outcome, ApprovedBy, and ApprovalDate
Create milestone record in RequestAuditLog (ActionType: Approved / Rejected)
Send completion notification to Requester and AssignedAnalyst
Query ComplianceRequests where Status ne 'Closed'
Evaluate TargetDueDateTime against current timestamp and warning window
If approaching deadline: send early-warning alert to AssignedAnalyst
If overdue and EscalationFlag eq false: update EscalationFlag, SLABreachFlag, EscalatedTo, create Escalated audit event, and alert supervisor
Verify Status column modified via Get Changes token
Create milestone record in RequestAuditLog (ActionType: Status Changed)
Verify CompletionDateTime populated; stamp utcNow() if empty
Create milestone record in RequestAuditLog (ActionType: Closed)
Dispatch archival confirmation email to Requester
